svg.title: Graph of standard Gibbs energy change against absolute temperature for four kinds of reaction. Each line starts at the left axis at the value of delta H and slopes with gradient minus delta S. The horizontal line through zero divides the non-spontaneous region above from the spontaneous region below. Delta H negative, delta S positive: starts below zero and falls further, so it is always spontaneous. Delta H positive, delta S negative: starts above zero and rises, so it is never spontaneous. Delta H positive, delta S positive: starts above zero and falls, crossing zero at a crossover temperature, so it is spontaneous above that temperature. Delta H negative, delta S negative: starts below zero and rises, crossing zero at a crossover temperature, so it is spontaneous below that temperature.
